summary: Frontend-only verification of the ScreenDetail 'Choose from library' feature per iteration 3 review request. All edge cases in the request passed: library picker lists existing media without upload, multi-select with numbered badges, deselect reorders remaining picks, Add button disabled when empty and shows count when selected, adding videos results in duration=0 (no seconds box), same media file added to two different screens (Casa Lola: Main Menu Left + Main Menu Right) is truly shared (Media Library still shows exactly 7 files, both screens play the same media_id), playlist.version bumps on add (2 -> 3), items persist across full page reload, and remove/persist still works. Regression smoke: /media, /devices, /playlists load cleanly. State restored to pre-test values after run. Image-duration case not exercised because the library only contains videos (per the review request that is acceptable / optional).

issues: When 0 tiles are picked the Add button reads 'Add  to this TV' with a double space (empty count interpolated). Purely cosmetic — button is correctly disabled in that state.

critical_code_review_comments: ScreenDetail.jsx line 449: 'Add {picked.length || ""} to this TV' — when picked.length===0 this renders a stray double space. Consider hiding the count entirely or using a conditional (`picked.length ? ` ${picked.length}` : ''`).

openLibrary() re-fetches /media every open, which is fine, but there is no loading state shown in the dialog between open and fetch — a tiny 'Loading…' placeholder would prevent a brief empty-state flash on slow networks.

addPicked() optimistically closes the dialog before persist() completes; if PUT /screens/{id}/content fails the user only sees a toast and the picked state is already reset. Consider keeping the dialog open until success or offering a retry.
seed_data_creation: None. Test appended 2 library videos to Screen A and 1 to Screen B, then restored both screens' playlists via PUT /api/screens/{id}/content back to their exact initial items. No media files uploaded or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Choose from library' feature on /screens/{id} is fully working end-to-end. All required data-testids exist (screen-choose-library-button, screen-library-dialog, screen-library-grid, screen-library-item-{mediaId}, screen-library-add, screen-upload-button, screen-file-input, screen-dropzone, screen-content-items, screen-content-item-{n}, screen-remove-item-{n}, screen-item-duration-{n}). If image-duration case must be verified, upload a small PNG via screen-upload-button first — the library currently contains 7 mp4 videos only.
rca of the issue: Original bug: users could only upload new media on a screen page even though a shared Media Library existed. Fix (frontend-only): ScreenDetail now offers a primary 'Choose from library' button opening a Dialog that lists all org media (GET /api/media). Multi-select with ordered badges; on confirm, PUT /api/screens/{id}/content is called with existing items concatenated with the picked ones (video->duration 0, image->duration 10). Verified: no new media rows created (media count unchanged 7 before/after), same media_id present on multiple screens, playlist.version bumped by the backend's normalize_items().
